description: Approves an image post held for review so it becomes ready to publish. Use when a manager wants to clear a post waiting for review (status draft). Not for publishing now (use run_social_automation_now). Returns the post with status ready; it is not posted here, the next automation run can publish it. Managers only; fails while safety checks still fail.

drop_id.description: ID of the drop. Get it from list_team_drops or create_drop.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: approve_drop
title: Approve held social post
